what_this_is: A REMOTE ARCHIVAL RETIREMENT. Unlike logs/shared/analyses/autoinit_relay_retention_20260822.json, the objects below have NO byte-identical local copy: after this runs, no copy of these weights exists anywhere. What survives is the binding record -- identity, content hash, training config, run manifest and every scored evaluation -- all git-tracked. The maintainer authorized exactly this trade on 2026-09-30.
authorised_by: Maintainer decision, 2026-09-30. Verbatim scope: delete historical large checkpoints where (a) the experiment/probe is completed and validly scored, (b) its measurements, per-sample evidence, descriptors, identities, hashes, configs, manifests and closeout records are already durable, (c) no currently authorized downstream consumer requires the checkpoint WEIGHTS, and (d) deletion removes no canonical release artifact, no irreplaceable lineage/input artifact, and no checkpoint still required for an unscored or resumable measurement. Decided under AGENTS.md P8.4 (artifacts follow consumers, not campaigns). Purpose: reclaim enough Hugging Face private capacity for formal C3's nine 2.22 GiB probes.
supersedes_rule: The 2026-08-22 retirement refused every object without a byte-identical local copy, which is why e1_scaling_20260801 was recorded then as 'the largest and most obviously obsolete group, and untouchable for exactly this reason'. That rule was stricter than the maintainer's: it protected bytes by copy-count rather than by consumer. This retirement applies the consumer rule instead. The sole-copy rule is NOT repealed for anything outside the set below.
method: HfApi.permanently_delete_lfs_files(rewrite_history=True), selected by exact file_oid identity, executed by scripts/autoinit/retire_relay_copies.py --archival-authorization. Ordinary deletion reclaims nothing on this account -- measured twice -- because LFS is billed including history.

_retired_is_a_request_not_a_result: This list names WHAT to retire. Every safety property is re-derived per object by the executing script against the live relay; a path here that fails any check is refused, not deleted. The measured outcome -- oids, bytes, before/after headroom -- is written to quota_measured below by the run itself.

expected.requirement: nine C3 probes at 2,383,697,920 bytes each

quota_measured._method: The LFS batch endpoint performs the quota check BEFORE any bytes move, so this costs $0 and stores nothing. Every request used FRESH RANDOM oids: an oid that already exists dedups and returns success regardless of quota, which is a false PASS. Occupancy is the summed LFS inventory across BOTH private repos, which is the billing basis (repo_info.usedStorage lags).
quota_measured.one_probe_2_22_gib: PASS — 200, 1/1 objects granted an upload action
quota_measured.nine_probes_19_98_gib: PASS — 200, 9/9 objects granted an upload action
quota_measured.verdict: BOTH PASS. Capacity verified for formal C3's nine 2.22 GiB probes, with 12.54 GiB of margin beyond the nine.
quota_measured._the_check_that_was_missing: attempt66 trained nine probes over 12.5 hours for $13.67 and preserved none: every upload was refused for private-storage quota. This call costs seconds and is now a launch precondition rather than a fact someone remembers.

preserved_metadata: The small config/tokenizer/run_manifest sidecars of the retired arms remain on the relay as reconstruction and accountability metadata; only the large weight objects are removed.
